Hi Alice / team,

Thanks again for the productive discovery call yesterday. We’re ready to lock in a POC kickoff that brings AE/SE + customer engineering + procurement + security into one session so we can align success criteria, timeline, and owners. To make scheduling efficient I put together a short availability matrix and a gate checklist we’ll use during the kickoff.

Quick asks:
- Alice: which 90-minute windows next week work for your engineering/security stakeholders? Please include preferred days and any blackout windows (on-call rotations, maintenance windows).

- Dev / Camila: can you be primary SE and secondary for technical acceptance criteria?

I’ve attached a lightweight checklist (redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx) and a SOC2 snapshot for your security team to review. I’ll follow up with a proposed calendar invite once I have availability.

Thanks,

Thanks team — adding technical detail so the kickoff can be productive.

Proposed kickoff agenda (90 mins):
- 0–10m: introductions + success metrics (AE lead)
- 10–35m: infra overview & data flow (Customer eng + SE)
- 35–60m: integration runbook + required access (SE lead)
- 60–75m: security evidence walkthrough (security contact)
- 75–90m: immediate next steps, owners, and timeline (AE/Procurement)

Success criteria (proposal):
- Technical: end-to-end sample generate from HelmTech staging with <= 250ms median token latency under test traffic (SE acceptance)
- Data: no PII persisted in Redwood logs; KV/prefix caching respects customer retention window (security acceptance)
- Operational: on-call rotation and escalation path documented (ops acceptance)

Owners:
- AE: Ben Carter (commercial, timeline)
- SE: Dev Patel (integration, acceptance tests)
- Customer Eng: Alice Wu / John Cloud (infra coordination)
- Procurement: procurement@helmtech.com (contracting)
- Security: security.ops@helmtech.com (evidence & acceptance)

I’ve attached a short checklist and a SOC2 snapshot for your security team. Also noting: we can provide a temporary test token and a restricted staging model for the POC.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com
